description: Standardized pre-approved commands for Google Antigravity CLI across developer workstations.

core_inspection.description: Read-only system inspection, file reading, and search utilities.

safe_file_operations.description: Non-destructive file and directory creation, moving, and permission adjustments (rm is deliberately excluded).

git_hygiene.description: Standard version control workflows and inspection commands.

github_governance.description: GitHub CLI automation and repository standardisation tools.

system_and_environment.description: Querying workstation environment, hostnames, and user identities.

package_querying.description: Package manager queries and manifest inspections without administrative elevation.

test_runners_and_runtimes.description: Common development runtimes and automated test harnesses.

local_workflows.description: Workstation provisioning scripts and Antigravity standardisation tooling.

context_and_memory_optimization.description: Context compression, reversible retrieval, and AST-based repository packing tools.
